name: What steps are involved in the interior painting process?

mainEntity.name: What steps are involved in the interior painting process?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our interior painting process begins with protecting all furniture, flooring, and non-painted surfaces. Next, we prepare the walls by cleaning, patching holes, filling cracks, and sanding uneven areas. After preparation, a primer is applied if necessary, followed by two coats of premium paint. Finally, we conduct a thorough clean-up, replace furniture, and perform a final inspection with you to ensure satisfaction with the completed work. Communication is maintained throughout each stage.
acceptedAnswer.description: The interior painting process involves preparation (protecting, patching, sanding), priming, two coats of paint, cleanup, and a final inspection.
